architecture.description: Trace repository structure, data flow, and CLI or Web API boundaries.

cli-development.description: Add or change Go CLI commands, flags, handlers, TUIs, or mutating behavior.

testing.description: Build, test, reproduce bugs, and use the devcontainer or ssenv.

e2e-runbooks.description: Write or run ai_docs/tests E2E runbooks, or verify on a Windows guest.

frontend.description: Change React, CSS, layout, or visual behavior in the dashboard, website, or Herdr panel.

documentation.description: Update README files, website docs, command flags, translations, or the built-in skill.

release.description: Write changelogs or release notes, bump versions, tag, or release.

audit.description: Read-only consistency checks for flags, docs, tests, targets, handler splits, oplog, or Web API.

pull-requests.description: Open a pull request or handle its review comments, including Codex review.

ai-context.description: Maintain the documentation router and fix topic, path, budget, or orphan check failures.
